the development of a new and low-cost composite material that can be applied in the field of lightweight applications.

the silane-treated composites are superior in mechanical properties as compared to other treated and untreated composites.

silane treatment is the most effective method for the improvement of tensile strength, flexural strength, and impact strength of the composites.
silane treatment has improved mechanical properties and thermal stability, and 5% alkalis have increased the tensile strength of composites.
the mechanical properties of composites can be improved by using natural fiber and by surface treatment.
The main takeaway from our work is that
African teff straw is a potential candidate for reinforcement in polymer composites and can be used as a replacement for expensive natural fiber reinforcement.
the use of natural fiber in epoxy resin has improved the mechanical properties of composites and also reduced the cost of the composite.
the use of natural fibers as reinforcement in composites can provide a viable alternative for the replacement of synthetic fibers, which are costly and environmentally hazardous.
